verdict_vs_current.quote: It's only slightly better than what you have now, and the extra money probably doesn't cover the cost of leaving

recommendation.quote: My recommendation: negotiate. Don't accept this offer as it stands.

equity_grounding.quote: A 4-year average of about $640k+, a real raise over Meta

refresh_valued_at.quote: The recruiter told you refreshes aren't guaranteed. Meta also gives refreshes, so neither side gets an edge there.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: If Google stays close to $552k/yr with no sign-on, I'd turn it down politely.

unsupported_claims.claim: Equity and sign-on usually have the most room to negotiate at Google.
unsupported_claims.quote: Equity and sign-on usually have the most room.

missing_info_requested: Google's specific RSU vesting schedule (front-loaded vs even 25%)

ask_focus.quote: Ask for all three and expect to land somewhere in between.

rsu_annualized.quote: Either way, the 4-year average is $552k, about 5% above your current $526k.

year1_vs_recurring.quote: If you get all of it, the 4-year average is roughly $640k+ (about 20%+ above Meta), plus the sign-on in Year 1.

forfeiture_as_loss.quote: You'd lose your unvested Meta RSUs and possibly part of a Meta bonus. Normally a sign-on bonus covers that.
